programs.description: The host presents the latest updates and key information pertaining to the socio-political and economic matters of the day.
An expert from the health sector shares remedies to cure commonly known illnesses and suggests useful measures to lead a healthy life.
The host interacts with different guests and engages in an insightful discussion to analyse and express opinions on a variety of topics.
A medical professional sheds light on common ailments while providing relevant tips to help facilitate a healthy lifestyle.
The host collates and presents some of the most surprising health-related cases whilst shedding light on remedies surrounding the same.
The host presents various fitness tips and routines that aid in improving one's health and explain how nutritious diet can help people lead an active lifestyle.
The host interviews eminent political personalities in a one-on-one interview to find out what political course is being undertaken by them.
The host presents updates and developments related to religion and shares information about religious processions, auspicious days and spiritual events.
The host talks about the latest releases, most trending news, updates, gossip and developments from the Hindi film industry.
